data.title: Jeaustin Campos renuncia como técnico del Real España por falta de pagos
data.description: San Pedro Sula, Cortés.- Real España se quedó sin entrenador. Jeaustin Campos ya es historia en la institución aurinegra luego de confirmarse que puso la renuncia y se despidió con un emotivo mensaje a través de sus redes sociales. El estratega costarricense y su asistente Hugo Viegas presentaron su dimisión con efecto inmediato, y uno de los grandes motivos se debe a la crisis financiera que atraviesa el club catedrático. Cabe mencionar que Campos no estuvo presente en el entrenamiento que realizó el primer equipo este viernes de cara al encuentro del domingo contra Choloma por la quinta fecha del Apertura 2026. Jorge 'Pitbull' Claros , preparador físico de las reservas, dirigió la práctica. El detonante principal ha sido una deuda económica de aproximadamente cuatro meses de sueldo hacia él y sus asistentes. La tensión aumentó considerablemente luego de que el equipo cancelara entrenamientos debido a que los fisioterapeutas y utileros tampoco se presentaron por falta de pagos. "Un saludo a todos, queremos comunicarles que el día de hoy, como cuerpo técnico, hemos decidido finalizar nuestra relación laboral con el Club Real España . Ha sido difícil por el cariño, el respeto y la admiración que le tenemos a la institución, los jugadores (mención especial por su compromiso y entrega), así como los demás compañeros", anunció el costarricense. De esta manera, Jeaustin Campos se va de Real España sin pena ni gloria, ya que en dos años y medio en el cargo no logró levantar títulos. Entre los aspectos más destacados es que mantuvo al equipo en la pelea de los primeros puestos de la Liga Nacional y logró liderazgos temporales en las vueltas regulares de los torneos. La noticia llega en un momento donde la entidad aurinegra acaba de lanzar su nueva aplicación oficial llamada 'Nación Real España' para conectar de manera digital con su afición. Desde ahí se podrá comprar boletos para los partidos y contiente calendario de juegos, noticias actualizadas y clips exclusivos. También cuenta con opciones para hacerte miembro del club, realizar donaciones, tienda y streaming en vivo.
data.translatedTitle: Jeaustin Campos resigns as coach of Real España due to lack of payments
data.translatedDescription: San Pedro Sula, Cortés.- Real España was left without a coach. Jeaustin Campos is already history in the gold-colored institution after it was confirmed that he resigned and said goodbye with an emotional message through his social networks. The Costa Rican strategist and his assistant Hugo Viegas presented their resignation with immediate effect, and one of the main reasons is due to the financial crisis that the university is going through. It is worth mentioning that Campos was not present in the training that the first team carried out this Friday ahead of Sunday's match against Choloma for the fifth date of Apertura 2026. Jorge 'Pitbull' Claros, physical trainer of the reserves, directed the practice. The main trigger has been a financial debt of approximately four months' salary towards him and his assistants. Tension increased considerably after the team canceled training sessions because the physiotherapists and props also did not show up due to lack of payments. "Greetings to everyone, we want to inform you that today, as a coaching staff, we have decided to end our working relationship with the Real España Club. It has been difficult because of the love, respect and admiration we have for the institution, the players (special mention for their commitment and dedication), as well as the other teammates," the Costa Rican announced. In this way, Jeaustin Campos leaves Real España without pain or glory, since in two and a half years in office he failed to win titles. Among the most notable aspects is that he kept the team in the fight for the first places in the National League and achieved temporary leadership in the regular rounds of the tournaments. The news comes at a time when the Aurinegra entity has just launched its new official application called 'Nación Real España' to connect digitally with its fans. From there you can buy tickets for the games and a full game schedule, updated news and exclusive clips. It also has options to become a club member, make donations, store and live streaming.

data.title: Joven de 19 años es señalada de haber matado con unas tijeras a un sastre en Teupasenti
data.description: El Paraísp, Honduras.- Agentes de la Dirección Policial de Investigaciones ( DPI ) capturaron a una joven de 19 años, señalada como presunta responsable del asesinato de un sastre de 75 años ocurrido dentro de una vivienda en el barrio Guanacaste de Teupasenti, El Paraíso. La víctima fue identificada como Juan Moreno Murillo, de 75 años , de oficio sastre y miembro de un reconocido conjunto de marimba de la zona. De acuerdo con el reporte de la DPI, la joven presuntamente sostenía una relación sentimental con Moreno Murillo y se encontraba en la vivienda del adulto mayor cuando ocurrió el hecho violento. Según la investigación preliminar, la joven habría intentado robarle algunas pertenencias y dinero a Moreno Murillo. Sin embargo, el hombre supuestamente descubrió sus intenciones, lo que habría provocado una discusión entre ambos. El reporte policial establece que el intercambio verbal posteriormente habría escalado hasta una agresión física entre la joven y el adulto mayor. En medio del altercado, la sospechosa habría tomado unas tijeras que Moreno Murillo utilizaba en su trabajo de sastre y presuntamente lo atacó en reiteradas ocasiones. El adulto mayor sufrió varias heridas provocadas con el objeto cortopunzante y murió dentro de su vivienda, ubicada en el barrio Guanacaste de Teupasenti. Tras las primeras diligencias investigativas, agentes de la DPI identificaron y localizaron a la joven de 19 años, quien fue capturada como sospechosa de la muerte de Moreno Murillo. La detenida será puesta a disposición de las autoridades competentes para continuar con el proceso legal correspondiente, mientras se desarrollan las investigaciones para esclarecer completamente las circunstancias del crimen.
data.translatedTitle: 19-year-old girl is accused of having killed a tailor in Teupasenti with scissors
data.translatedDescription: El Paraísp, Honduras.- Agents from the Police Investigation Directorate (DPI) captured a 19-year-old girl, identified as allegedly responsible for the murder of a 75-year-old tailor that occurred inside a home in the Guanacaste neighborhood of Teupasenti, El Paraíso. The victim was identified as Juan Moreno Murillo, 75 years old, a tailor by trade and a member of a renowned marimba group in the area. According to the DPI report, the young woman allegedly had a romantic relationship with Moreno Murillo and was in the older adult's home when the violent incident occurred. According to the preliminary investigation, the young woman had tried to steal some belongings and money from Moreno Murillo. However, the man allegedly discovered his intentions, which would have caused an argument between the two. The police report establishes that the verbal exchange later escalated to a physical attack between the young woman and the older adult. In the middle of the altercation, the suspect took some scissors that Moreno Murillo used in his work as a tailor and allegedly attacked him repeatedly. The older adult suffered several injuries caused by the sharp object and died inside his home, located in the Guanacaste neighborhood of Teupasenti. After the first investigative procedures, DPI agents identified and located the 19-year-old girl, who was captured as a suspect in the death of Moreno Murillo. The detainee will be placed at the disposal of the competent authorities to continue with the corresponding legal process, while investigations are carried out to fully clarify the circumstances of the crime.

data.title: Asesinan con unas tijeras a un sastre de 75 años en su casa en Teupasenti
data.description: El Paraíso, Honduras.- Un sastre fue asesinado de manera violenta dentro de su vivienda, ubicada en el barrio Guanacaste del municipio de Teupasenti , departamento de El Paraíso. La víctima fue identificada como Juan Moreno Murillo , de 75 años, quien habría sido atacada en reiteradas ocasiones con unas tijeras, de acuerdo con la información preliminar sobre el crimen. Moreno Murillo era conocido en la zona por dedicarse durante años al oficio de la sastrería. Además, formaba parte de un reconocido grupo de marimba de Teupasenti. El hecho ocurrió dentro de la vivienda de la víctima, donde las autoridades realizaron las primeras diligencias para establecer las circunstancias en las que se produjo el ataque. Las hipótesis preliminares apuntan a que el crimen podría estar relacionado con un robo. Sin embargo, esta línea de investigación deberá ser confirmada conforme avancen las indagaciones. Durante las primeras investigaciones, las autoridades identificaron que una jovencita salió de la vivienda de Moreno Murillo a la hora en que ocurrió el crimen, gracias a las cámaras de seguridad que había en la casa. Debido a esta circunstancia, la joven es considerada preliminarmente como la principal sospechosa del asesinato, mientras los investigadores trabajan para determinar su posible participación en el hecho. Las autoridades continúan recopilando evidencias y testimonios que permitan esclarecer el móvil del crimen y establecer qué ocurrió dentro de la vivienda del adulto mayor. El caso permanece bajo investigación y serán las diligencias de las autoridades competentes las que determinen las responsabilidades correspondientes por la muerte de Juan Moreno Murillo.
data.translatedTitle: A 75-year-old tailor is murdered with scissors in his home in Teupasenti
data.translatedDescription: El Paraíso, Honduras.- A tailor was violently murdered inside his home, located in the Guanacaste neighborhood of the municipality of Teupasenti, department of El Paraíso. The victim was identified as Juan Moreno Murillo, 75 years old, who was allegedly attacked repeatedly with scissors, according to preliminary information about the crime. Moreno Murillo was known in the area for dedicating himself to the tailoring trade for years. In addition, he was part of a renowned Teupasenti marimba group. The incident occurred inside the victim's home, where the authorities carried out the first steps to establish the circumstances under which the attack occurred. Preliminary hypotheses suggest that the crime could be related to a robbery. However, this line of investigation must be confirmed as the investigations progress. During the first investigations, the authorities identified that a young girl left Moreno Murillo's home at the time the crime occurred, thanks to the security cameras in the house. Due to this circumstance, the young woman is preliminarily considered the main suspect in the murder, while investigators work to determine her possible participation in the incident. The authorities continue to collect evidence and testimonies that will clarify the motive for the crime and establish what happened inside the elderly adult's home. The case remains under investigation and it will be the proceedings of the competent authorities that determine the corresponding responsibilities for the death of Juan Moreno Murillo.

data.title: OLIVER ORRO ⟩ Katus, kuhu maja viid?
data.description: Kui mõni väike poiss kandis väga suurt koolikotti või muud ebaproportsionaalselt mahukat pampu, küsiti vanasti ikka naljatlemisi «Kott, kuhu poisi viid?». See tuleb mulle sageli meelde, kui näen mõnd eriti muljetavaldava kaldkatusega hoonet, kus katuse maht moodustab enam kui poole maja kogukõrgusest, kirjutab arhitektuuriajaloolane ja muinsuskaitsja Oliver Orro.
data.translatedTitle: OLIVER ORRO ⟩ The roof, where do you take the house?
data.translatedDescription: If a small boy was carrying a very large school bag or other disproportionately bulky bag, in the old days they would still jokingly ask "Bag, where are you taking the boy?". This often comes to mind when I see a building with a particularly impressive pitched roof, where the volume of the roof makes up more than half of the building's total height, writes architectural historian and conservationist Oliver Orro.

data.title: Nafta odavneb, gaas kallineb: miks energiaturg on kaheks löödud?
data.description: Naftahind on hakanud Lähis-Ida sõjast hoolimata langema, kuid Euroopa gaasihind püsib kõrgeimal tasemel alates 2023. aasta jaanuarist. Prognoosid näitavad, et erinevus võib jätkuda: suuremad pangad ootavad Brenti toornafta hinnaks aasta viimases kvartalis 70–80 dollarit barrelist, gaasiturg jääb aga talve eel pingeliseks. Hormuzi väina olukord on mõlema turu jaoks keskne, kuid hindu mõjutavad ka varude tase, ilm, nõudlus ja konkurents LNG-tarnete pärast.
data.translatedTitle: Oil is getting cheaper, gas is getting more expensive: why is the energy market split in two?
data.translatedDescription: Oil prices have started to fall despite the war in the Middle East, but European gas prices remain at their highest level since January 2023. Forecasts indicate that the gap may continue: major banks expect Brent crude oil prices to be between $70 and $80 per barrel in the final quarter of the year, while the gas market remains tight ahead of winter. The situation in the Strait of Hormuz is central to both markets, but prices are also affected by inventory levels, weather, demand and competition for LNG supplies.

data.title: Tohoh: kuidas vaalade laul saab levida kiiremini kui heli?
data.description: Heeringavaalade laulu mõõtnud teadlased sattusid ootamatu füüsikalise nähtuse otsa, kui arvutused näitasid helilainete liikumiskiiruseks absurdseid väärtusi. Selgus, et merevees otse ja ookeanipinnalt tagasi põrkudes liituvad helilained tekitavad ajalist interferentsi – ilmingut, mis paneb signaali energiatipud näiliselt liikuma helikiirusest kiiremini.
data.translatedTitle: Tohoh: How can whale song travel faster than sound?
data.translatedDescription: Scientists measuring the song of herring whales came across an unexpected physical phenomenon when calculations showed absurd values ​​for the speed of sound waves. It turned out that when sound waves combine directly in seawater and bounce off the ocean surface, they create temporal interference, a phenomenon that causes the signal's energy peaks to appear to travel faster than the speed of sound.

data.title: VAATA OTSEÜLEKANNET ⟩ NASA saadab täna kosmosesse tumeainet jahtiva teleskoobi, mida Tumpi valitsused püüdsid korduvalt tühistada

data.translatedTitle: WATCH LIVE ⟩ NASA launches dark matter-hunting telescope into space today, repeated attempts by Trump governments to cancel
data.translatedDescription: NASA plans to send the $4.3 billion Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope into space today, August 30. The observatory with Hubble's sharpness and field of view a hundred times wider will study dark energy and dark matter, search for exoplanets and map billions of galaxies. However, the completion of the telescope was far from certain: Donald Trump's administration repeatedly tried to stop its funding.

data.title: Russia Extends Fuel Export Ban Amid Record Refinery Strikes
data.description: The Russian government has extended its ban on diesel and marine fuel exports by producers until Sept. 30 in an effort to stabilize the domestic market. The extension follows a record 21 Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian oil refineries in August, driving refining capacity to its lowest level in over two decades. August refining averaged just 3.8 million barrels per day, causing a 20% drop in gasoline supplies and a 23% drop in diesel production.

data.title: Death Toll in Myla Ammunition Depot Blast Reaches 38
data.description: President Volodymyr Zelensky announced on Sunday, Aug. 30, that the death toll from a Russian drone strike on an ammunition warehouse in the village of Myla (Bucha district, Kyiv region) has reached 38 people. Twenty people were injured, including two children, and four remain missing following the Friday night blast, which triggered massive secondary detonations. Zelensky noted that State Emergency Service pyrotechnic units are working around the clock to clear unexploded ordnance from the heavily contaminated area. Zelensky also highlighted a massive surge in Russian aerial attacks, stating that over the past week, Russian forces have launched nearly 2,000 attack drones, over 1,600 aerial bombs, and 31 missiles, including North Korean ballistics, against Ukraine.

data.title: Ukraine’s Scientific Independence
data.description: Ukraine's scientific independence in 1991 was built on a rich Soviet-era legacy rather than starting from scratch, producing figures such as welding pioneer Borys Paton and Fields Medal winner Maryna Viazovska. Since then, the country has developed strengths in materials science, pharmaceuticals and radiation-detection technology, while deepening ties with European research networks. Despite severe damage from Russia's full-scale invasion, Ukraine's scientific community retains the creative, independent spirit that has long defined its research culture.

data.title: Germany to Blame Russia for Leipzig Drone Attack, Plan Sanctions
data.description: The German government is preparing to officially blame Russia for the Aug. 4 explosive drone incident at Leipzig/Halle Airport and impose broad sanctions. Chancellor Friedrich Merz is expected to announce the measures early next week, potentially aligning with new EU sanctions. Berlin reportedly considers standard diplomatic expulsions insufficient and is exploring tougher penalties, including increased military aid to Ukraine.

data.title: Car Bomb Targets Olenivka Prison Official in Occupied Donetsk
data.description: On the night of Aug. 29, a car bombing in temporarily occupied Donetsk targeted Dmytro Neielov, the first deputy head of the Olenivka penal colony. Neielov is accused of torturing and humiliating Ukrainian prisoners of war and civilians, and his current condition is unknown. In the spring of 2026, Ukrainian authorities charged Neielov in absentia with war crimes. The Olenivka colony is notorious for a July 2022 explosion that killed about 50 Ukrainian POWs.

data.title: Drones Strike Yeysk Airfield and Major Kirishi Oil Refinery in Russia
data.description: Early Sunday morning, Aug. 30, Ukrainian drones struck a military airfield in Yeysk, Krasnodar Krai, and the KINEF oil refinery in the Leningrad region. Satellite data and local reports indicated fires and secondary detonations at the Yeysk airfield. In the Leningrad region, Governor Alexander Drozdenko claimed 42 drones were intercepted but confirmed a fire at the Kirishi industrial zone. The KINEF refinery is one of Russia’s largest, processing roughly 6% of the country’s oil.

data.title: Ukrainian Perception of Poland Plummets to 50%
data.description: A Rating Group survey conducted between August 4 and 9 found that only 50% of Ukrainians now consider Poland a friendly country, a sharp decline from 79% in February 2024 and 94% in 2023. The poll also revealed differing views on Polish leadership, with Prime Minister Donald Tusk viewed positively by 45% of respondents, while President Karol Nawrocki received a 62% negative rating. Meanwhile, France, the UK, and Germany topped the list of nations perceived as friendly by Ukrainians.

data.title: Hungary Elects Anna Unger to Lead New Anti-Corruption Body
data.description: Hungary’s parliament elected political analyst Anna Unger to head the newly formed National Asset Recovery and Protection Office (NVVH) on Aug. 28. The vote passed 137-7, though opposition Fidesz and KDNP lawmakers boycotted the session. The NVVH, a flagship institution of the Tisza government, is tasked with recovering misused public assets and identifying officials who enabled corruption. Unger’s mandate begins on Sept. 1. She cautioned that while indictments may be issued, final legal judgments in corruption cases will take time, prompting debate over the pace of the anti-corruption drive.

data.title: Russia Test-Launches ICBM Days After CIA Chief Visits Moscow
data.description: Russia’s Strategic Missile Forces conducted a training launch of a solid-fuel intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) from the Plesetsk cosmodrome on Friday, Aug. 28. The warheads successfully hit their designated targets on the Kamchatka Peninsula. While the specific missile was unnamed, Russia’s solid-fuel arsenal primarily consists of Topol and Yars systems, which possess a 10,500-kilometer range and form 56% of the country’s strategic land-based nuclear arsenal.

data.description: European officials stated there is no intelligence indicating Russia is preparing for a conventional military attack on NATO or the Baltic states, contradicting reports that CIA Director John Ratcliffe’s recent Moscow visit was focused on preventing such a strike. data.title: Baltic Nations Form Task Force Against Hybrid Threats
data.description: German Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt hosted counterparts from nine European nations to discuss escalating hybrid warfare in the Baltic Sea region. The coalition agreed to establish a joint task force to protect critical infrastructure and improve drone defense through joint exercises following recent incidents, including a drone attack at Leipzig airport and severed sub-sea cables. The nations are also lobbying to prioritize defense spending in the EU’s upcoming seven-year budget negotiations, currently led by the Irish Council Presidency.

data.title: DSP o Maquiavélico Ganancioso
data.description: Guineenses, mais uma vez, venho para vos alertar sobre o perigo que Domingos Simões Pereira representa para a Guiné-Bissau. Faço esse alerta a todos os guineenses sem exceção que se encontre no país ou no estrangeiro, ao PAIGC em especial e na pessoa do Cipriano Cassamá em concreto. Alerta esse sobre o verdadeiro DSP, o verdadeiro espírito que move esse sujeito, o qual alguns ainda continuam a acreditar para não dizer adorar. Domingos Simões Pereira é um manipulador, um verdadeiro chantagista e calculista provavelmente, tipo de comportamento que ultrapassa o nível de psicopata. U m ambicioso desmedido, um verdadeiro criminoso que sabe como e quando cometer o crime. Ele jamais coabitaria não só com JOMAV, assim como com qualquer presidente que seria eleito, a não ser o que ele apoiou disfarçadamente. Isto porque ele tem sua própria agenda, e o PAIGC é simplesmente uma plataforma para sua concretização. DSP jamais coabitaria com JOMAV porque o seu candidato preferido era o Paulo Gomes e sempre será, o qual juntamente com Tchitchi vão delineando mecanismo de modo a serem os novos donos da Guiné-Bissau. Segundo eles este é um processo a médio prazo, e é preciso coragem e paciência para concretiza-lo. Ganhar o congresso não importa em que circunstância e ter novamente o partido na mão, é uma fase concluída em proveito deles, enquanto verdadeiros militantes do PAIGC estão a bater palmas. Depois dessa eleição legislativa, não importa o resultado, o Cipriano Cassama que se prepare a mala ou fica de bico fechado, pois o candidato preferido para o partido será o Paulo Gomes, e esse sim deve ter a voz dentro do partido. DSP é um ambicioso desmedido, nunca teve consideração por ninguém, JOMAV muito menos, o sujeito é um maquiavélico nato, Cipriano Casama será descartado quando menos esperar podes tomar a nota. Guineenses, falar do Paulo Gomes e Tchitchi é falar do MCCI e demais outras organizações e personalidades camufladas no nosso país. Esses dois indivíduos são os principais financiadores do MCCI e demais outras personalidades boca de aluguel na cidade de Bissau. O MCCI, Milícia idealizado por JBV e DSP, agora financiado e dirigido por "futuro triângulo do poder" ou seja, "DSP, Paulo Gomes e Tchitchi", têm 3 principais objectivos: 1º Perturbar a ordem pública em nome da cidadania, difamar e tentar descredibilizar qualquer que seja organizações ou indivíduos não alinhados ao triângulo, de modo a suportar suas caminhadas na busca do poder. 2º Caso se concretize o objectivo do triângulo, o papel da Milícia do MCCI passará a ser de vigilância constante a todos os adversários de modo a garantir falsa paz social e o poder de controlo. 3º Tentar ganhar credibilidade junto das organizações internacionais e regionais, através de suas visitas e actividades de fachada, para quando houver as tais actividades de perturbações de ordem pública, poderem ganhar notoriedade. Mas isso não deve preocupar ninguém, pois estão bem identificados e bem caçados, dentro e fora da Guiné-Bissau. Não tenho nada contra ninguém, mas quem continuar a perturbar verdadeira paz social dos guineenses em troca de benefícios como sempre foi nos últimos anos dessa crise, e que sempre tenho tolerado, então que fique claro "estou firme e determinado para tudo e todos". Para finalizar, gostaria de vos deixar uma reflexão com a seguinte frase: " Domingos Simões Pereira é um perigo grave para o futuro do país ". Isto porque publicar aqui tudo que é necessário para provar ou sustentar a razão dessa frase, só pode agravar ainda mais a paz social que tanto necessitamos. Chega, chega não podemos continuar a viver nessa turbulência vida toda, meus irmãos guineenses, não é saudável, é tóxico, não é justo para um povo que tanto sofreu. A disproportionately ambitious man, a true criminal who knows how and when to commit the crime. This is because he has his own agenda, and PAIGC is simply a platform for its achievement. To conclude, I would like to leave a reflection with the following sentence: " Domingos Simões Pereira is a serious danger for the future of the country ". Enough, enough, we cannot continue to live in this turbulence our whole lives, my Guinean brothers, it is not healthy, it is toxic, it is not fair for a people who have suffered so much. data.description: Os meios de comunicação também são as formas de manipulação mais utilizadas pelos poderes políticos, dado o seu impacto social. As informações são manipuladas não apenas tendo em vista omitir factos relevantes, mas também distorcer o conteúdo da informação veiculada, produzir ou forjar a opinião pública, de modo que a mesma se ajuste às ideias dos gananciosos. A única forma dos cidadãos evitarem cair nestes processos de manipulação é tornarem-se mais vigilantes em relação às instituições democráticas e aos órgãos de informação, adoptando uma atitude de permanente reflexão crítica sobre a informação que lhes é fornecida. Na Guiné-Bissau, nos últimos anos, cresceu exponencialmente o número de pessoas mediocres, pessoas sem escrúpulos ligadas à produção de rádios e outros meios de comunicação com influencia na nossa sociedade, gente que apesar da sua enorme influência na sociedade, trabalha na mais completa impunidade e sem qualquer controlo ético/democrático. Finge que preocupa com os problemas do país, mas só engana o povo honesto, humilde e trabalhador que infelizmente sofre muito, não sei até quando, devido a sua paciência e tolerância aos governantes como DSP, criminoso travestido em politico que vive na custa de povo e acima de tudo ainda fa-lo refem do próprio suor. Razão disso é que depois de perder a batalha nos meios de comunicações mais modernos nomeadamente os blogues onde investiu grandes somas do dinheiro de povo, para fazer a lavagem cerebral dos menos instruídos e não só.
